title: tc-work-item
description:
A work item card – title, status, a note, progress, due date, people, what it delivers, spent against budget and
effort – that opens as a link or a button.

heading.description: The work's title, and the card's control

status.description: Where the work stands: active, blocked, review, done or paused – shown in words with a mark

statusLabels.description: The statuses' names, merged over the defaults (Active, Blocked, In review, Done, Paused)

note.description: One line under the title: the blocker, the next step

progress.description: How far along, from 0 to 1; no bar when unset

due.description: When it's due, as epoch ms

now.description: The time to compare `due` with, as epoch ms; today when unset

outcome.description: What it delivers, as a tag, e.g. "fills 1 gap"

budget.description: The money it has; spent is shown against it

currency.description: The currency of `spent` and `budget`, as an ISO 4217 code

effort.description: The effort, written as shown, e.g. "1.5 FTE"

source.description: Where the item comes from when it's mirrored, e.g. "Synced · read-only"

locale.description: The language for dates and money, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's
